Fn::Sub:
permit(
  principal is AgentCore::OAuthUser,
  action in [AgentCore::Action::"retail___backend___get_customer",
    AgentCore::Action::"retail___backend___get_accounts",
    AgentCore::Action::"retail___backend___get_balance",
    AgentCore::Action::"retail___backend___get_profile",
    AgentCore::Action::"retail___backend___whoami",
    AgentCore::Action::"transaction___backend___get_payments",
    AgentCore::Action::"transaction___backend___get_beneficiaries",
    AgentCore::Action::"transaction___backend___whoami",
    AgentCore::Action::"lending___backend___get_loans",
    AgentCore::Action::"lending___backend___get_credit_score",
    AgentCore::Action::"lending___backend___check_eligibility",
    AgentCore::Action::"lending___backend___get_emi_details",
    AgentCore::Action::"lending___backend___calculate_emi",
    AgentCore::Action::"lending___backend___search_lending_policies",
    AgentCore::Action::"lending___backend___whoami"],
  resource == AgentCore::Gateway::"${GatewayArn}"
)
when {
  principal.hasTag("tid") && principal.getTag("tid") == "${TenantId}" &&
  principal.hasTag("azp") && principal.getTag("azp") == "${CallerClientId}" &&
  principal.hasTag("oid") && ["${UserList}"].contains(principal.getTag("oid")) &&
  principal.hasTag("scp") && principal.getTag("scp") == "access_as_user"
};
